text: OI! Listen up! Six dollars fifty for a FLAT WHITE in Brisbane, Kev! SIX FIFTY! That's fair dinkum ROBBERY, mate!
action: slams both fists on the desk then points aggressively at the camera like a debater making a closing argument

text: I did the maths, Kev. If I get one a day that's TWO GRAND a year! I could buy a jet ski! A JET SKI, mate!
action: shadow boxes the air then mimes riding a jet ski with both hands gripping invisible handlebars

text: Yeah, nah. You don't buy coffee daily, mate. You beg one off me every morning and call it 'content research'.
action: slow blinks while sipping from a stubby holder, sets it down with deliberate calm

text: Speaking of savings, mate, this episode is PROUDLY not sponsored by anyone, so I've invented 'BOOMER BREW' - it's just instant coffee in a servo cup, TWO BUCKS, GAME CHANGER!
action: holds up a crumpled servo cup with fake logo scrawled in texta, shakes it enthusiastically toward the lens

text: Wrap this up. That's servo instant in a cup you nicked from the bin. No wuckas, but that's cactus, mate, absolute cactus.
action: chews on a gum leaf while staring flatly into the lens, one eyebrow raised

text: Alright, alright, but here's the ABSOLUTE STREWTH of it - the cafe on my corner reckons it's 'ethically sourced', but so's me bloody thongs, doesn't mean they cost fifty bucks!
action: flexes both arms then gestures wildly toward Kev, wiping sweat off his brow with the back of his hand

text: Ground control to Boomer. It's Brisbane rent going through the roof, not the beans, dropkick. Landlords are flat out like a lizard drinking, squeezing every cafe on the strip.
action: yawns mid-sentence then slowly points one claw toward Boomer without lifting his head off the cushion

text: So it's not the coffee, it's the bloody RENT?! Mad as a cut snake, this whole city! Right, I'm boycotting cafes and drinking straight outta the jar!
action: freezes mid-flex with mouth open in realisation, then grabs an entire jar of instant coffee and tips it straight into his mouth
